episodes.synopsis: In the immersive online game Planet, Ichi is a member of the formidable Akabane Family; but offline, his real life family is a dysfunctional mess.
episodes.title: LOG IN

episodes.synopsis: After receiving a Declaration of War from the Pirates, Shiro and his sons go into enemy territory to discuss the matter with the Pirate Captain herself.
episodes.title: ERROR

episodes.synopsis: There's something strange about the monster the Akabanes are fighting against. Sensing danger, Shiro orders the family to log out immediately.
episodes.title: INSTALL

episodes.synopsis: Pico makes an unexpected decision before breaking through the barrier and confronting Ichi. Then, a mysterious person pays Asuma a visit.
episodes.title: UPGRADE

episodes.synopsis: With players everywhere reeling, Shigatera reveals his true feelings and intentions. Then, Pico returns and demands an explanation.
episodes.title: VIRUS

episodes.synopsis: Pico has been logging into Planet to escape her oppressively controlling mother. But then, Shiro tells her something that rocks her very foundation.
episodes.title: REMOVE

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bird begins appearing in Shigatera's real life world. Taichiro and his mother visit Asuma in the hospital — and are shocked by what they find.
episodes.title: BAN

episodes.synopsis: Taichiro and Asuma reveal some long-held secrets to each other. The mysterious woman appears again and warns Asuma not to log back into Planet.
episodes.title: RELOAD

episodes.synopsis: Hana tells Taichiro and Asuma about their father's involvement in Planet, Black Bird and more. Then, Taichiro tells Hana about his younger sister.
episodes.title: AR

episodes.synopsis: The whole family has been infected and are now back in Planet, but this dark world is nothing like the sunny paradise they once escaped into.
episodes.title: REGISTRY

episodes.synopsis: Kojiro wants to see his family before they leave for a distant shelter, but Asuma tells him to stay away. Then, Sasumata asks Shiro a striking question.
episodes.title: DEBUG

episodes.synopsis: As Ichi, Taichiro attacks a heartbroken and furious Leon. Meanwhile, Shiro tells Sasumata that he created them under a different name.
episodes.title: Hello, World
